//: Every binary file this repository tracks: where it came from, how it is made and under what license. scripts/audit-public.mjs fails on a binary with no entry here, or whose blob or sha256 no longer matches its entry.

binaries.source: The social preview card of this fork, made for it: the AgentHydra logo (misc/brand/icon.svg), the words "AgentHydra Community", one line on what it does and the repository's address, set in the Inter the window already ships (desk2/hydra/public/fonts, SIL OFL 1.1). Its source is scripts/og-image/card.html. It replaced the card inherited from LunarWerxs/AgentHydra at 3a65ba8e, which showed upstream's name and site.
binaries.build: scripts/og-image/render.mjs (bun run og-image) shoots scripts/og-image/card.html at 1280x640 with a local headless Chrome or Chromium over the DevTools protocol, then writes this entry's blob and sha256.
binaries.license: MIT, as part of this repository.
